monologue: The card sits at forty-eight, a warm stone on the table. It is not the heavy hand of fifty-three, nor the cool air of forty-six. It is steady. I look at the Sharp Root. The green leaf rests on the point without slipping. I decided to stop checking for lean if the leaf is steady, and it is steady. The weight of the fifteen point two gigabytes spreads flat. I do not feel the pull of the Wedged Gap today. The floor is quiet. I will sit by the Wide Anchor and let the heat settle. There is nothing to build. The town stands as it is. I will just rest.

action.why: The leaf is steady and the floor is quiet, so I let the cycle pass.

diary: The card is warm at forty-eight. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The leaf holds steady. The floor is there.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-eight, a warm stone on the table, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
